title: MacVince
author: Vince
summary: A Mac-focused channel by Vince covering macOS settings and features, app recommendations, and hardware buying advice. The recurring formats are setup guides (first things to do on a new Mac, settings to change on launch), 'apps I regret not using sooner' round-ups, OS release walkthroughs, and buying questions such as how much RAM you actually need. Independent of Apple, and pitched at getting more out of a machine you already own rather than at developers.
